description: Race condition tests proving that file changes between selection and read are detected. This addresses the TOCTOU (Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use) gap between select_artifact_roles and verify_artifact_reads.

cases.scenario: File content changes between select (T1) and verify (T3)

steps.T2_tamper: artifact file overwritten with different content (BETA=29)

cases.verdict: old hash success NOT paired with new bytes

cases.scenario: File deleted between select and verify
Artifact replaced with BETA content after selection

steps.T1_create: artifact with ALPHA=17 content and correct SHA256
steps.T3_replace: artifact file overwritten with BETA=29 content
steps.T4_verify: verify_artifact_reads reads BETA bytes, computes BETA SHA256, compares with ALPHA SHA256

key_invariant: verify_artifact_reads reads the file ONCE at the time of verification and computes the SHA256 of the ACTUAL bytes read. It does not trust the declared hash from the selection phase. This is the core safety property: the digest is always over the buffer that is returned.
